label: Baseline
note: First scored run. Judges ran on the agent's own model with the original judge prompts.

label: Round 2
note: Name + company person filter, one-detail paragraph, stricter grounding rules. Judges fixed and moved to gpt-oss-20b. A repeat run on the same code scored 76% grounding, 83% wrong-person and 93% quality.

label: Round 3
note: Company details must come from a source sentence the model quotes exactly; numbers must appear in the sources; full-name person match; follow-ups retry if they add time words not in the notes. A repeat run on the same code scored 97% grounding, 89% wrong-person and 90% quality.

label: Round 4
note: Adds a code check against pasted source text (quotation marks, more than 8 copied words, company described as we/our); the agent rewrites until it passes. Two test contacts renamed because their invented names matched real employees.
